@pytest.mark.parametrize(('compound_model', 'result'), compound_models.values())
def test_separable(compound_model, result):
    assert_allclose(is_separable(compound_model), result[0])

def test_nested_compound_model_separability():
    """
    Test that nested compound models compute separability correctly.
    
    This is a regression test for issue where separability_matrix incorrectly
    computed separability for nested CompoundModels like:
    Pix2Sky_TAN() & (Linear1D(10) & Linear1D(5))
    
    The issue was that the _cstack function was setting all values to 1 instead
    of preserving the separability matrix from nested compound models.
    """
    # Create the basic compound model: Linear1D & Linear1D
    cm = models.Linear1D(10) & models.Linear1D(5)
    
    # Test that it has correct separability (should be diagonal)
    expected_cm = np.array([[True, False], [False, True]])
    assert_allclose(separability_matrix(cm), expected_cm)
    
    # Create complex model: Pix2Sky_TAN & Linear1D & Linear1D
    complex_model = models.Pix2Sky_TAN() & models.Linear1D(10) & models.Linear1D(5)
    expected_complex = np.array([[True, True, False, False],
                                [True, True, False, False], 
                                [False, False, True, False],
                                [False, False, False, True]])
    assert_allclose(separability_matrix(complex_model), expected_complex)
    
    # Create nested model: Pix2Sky_TAN & (Linear1D & Linear1D)
    # This should have the same result as the complex model
    nested_model = models.Pix2Sky_TAN() & cm
    nested_result = separability_matrix(nested_model)
    
    # The key test: nested should equal complex (this was failing before the fix)
    assert_allclose(nested_result, expected_complex,
                    err_msg="Nested compound model separability should match "
                           "non-nested equivalent")
    
    # Also test that the last two rows are properly diagonal (separable)
    # This verifies that the Linear1D models remain independent
    assert nested_result[2, 2] == True and nested_result[2, 3] == False
    assert nested_result[3, 2] == False and nested_result[3, 3] == True


def test_custom_model_separable():
    @custom_model
    def model_a(x):
        return x

    assert model_a().separable

    @custom_model
    def model_c(x, y):
        return x + y

    assert not model_c().separable
    assert np.all(separability_matrix(model_c()) == [True, True])
